improvements.message: Consider adding more nuanced scoring logic to account for edge cases, such as records with missing or low-confidence metadata.
Enhance filtering to support advanced criteria, such as sentiment analysis or multi-select filters, for future scalability.
Implement IndexedDB for larger-scale persistence to overcome localStorage limitations in future iterations.
Expand the UX design specification to include accessibility considerations, such as keyboard navigation and screen reader support.
Add tests for edge cases, such as importing malformed JSON or handling extremely large input bundles.
Clarify the handling of missing or incomplete fields in the input schema to ensure robust data validation.
Include a troubleshooting section for common issues, such as browser compatibility or JSON parsing errors.

payload.quality_target: Enhance scalability, robustness, and accessibility for future iterations.
